title: Blue Book's Robert Friend sees the channeling session; told another agency has it

tellings.quote: And then the general says another agency has it hands off. And we never hear anything more.

plain: In 1959, Robert Friend, then head of Blue Book, the US Air Force's UFO study of the 1950s and 60s, was shown a session in Washington where a person claimed to be receiving messages from beings in space, and the government photo analyst Arthur Lundahl was also named in the affair. When Friend tried to follow it up, a general told him another agency had it and to keep his hands off, and nothing more was heard. The UFO researcher Grant Cameron tells this, crediting an 11-page memo about a meeting on July 9, 1959, and it would mean some other agency, not the Air Force, was quietly handling the subject.
